detail: Selected rare subgroup dependency stability; generic agreement is baseline only.
Repository may nominate genetic vulnerability hypotheses but cannot establish treatment actionability or patient benefit.
Sparse API fields omitted source and qc_pass, yielding zero pairable records; failed output preserved.
EXP-20260822-001 passed all frozen gates after implementation-only retry.
fc_clean_qn will not be used as final independent-replication evidence because cross-study harmonization may inflate agreement.
A 50-permutation synthetic test cannot attain p<0.01 because its minimum corrected p is 1/51; assertion changed to p<0.05. Scientific run remains fixed at 1000 permutations.
A scaled monotonic synthetic series legitimately crosses the -0.5 threshold; the test now verifies contingency completeness instead of incorrectly requiring zero discordant classifications.

Label-only audit before WRN outcome access found Broad 7 MSI/12 MSS, Sanger 10 MSI/19 MSS, and overlap 6 MSI/7 MSS; historical Broad fails the independent critic's frozen 8-per-class adequacy proposal.

Stopped the Project Score 2 combined archive at 68 MB after remote central-directory inspection established it contained combined products; incomplete archive moved to macOS Trash and remains recoverable.
Frozen processing-sensitivity audit before computing any panel-level bf_scaled or bf correlations; MSI-WRN outcomes remain sealed.
Frozen the four-tissue, within-tissue-pair MSI-WRN source-separated protocol and pushed commit 5470d9a before downloading or reading WRN scores.
First smoke command did not launch the analysis because stdout redirection targeted a missing results directory and status is a read-only zsh variable; rerun changed only shell plumbing.

A newly added known-digest test used an incorrect manually typed expected SHA-256; replaced it with the independently computed digest. Scientific inputs, cohort, thresholds, and outputs were unchanged.
Full frozen run passed discovery and held-out confirmation: Avana delta -0.7432 and KY delta -0.9307, both p=1/100001 with all four tissue effects negative; 16 tests passed.

Auditor exactly reproduced all 147 rows and statistics but found the initial implementation parsed KY endpoint values before the Avana gate and did not verify the sequence-map receipt; strict unseen-held-out wording blocked.

Recorded the protocol deviation, narrowed KY to a sequentially gated confirmation contrast, made endpoint parsing source-sequential, added sequence-map verification and discovery-failure/hash-coverage tests; 18 tests pass.
Added a full run() discovery-failure regression proving only Avana screen IDs are extracted and KY confirmation remains null; final suite has 19 passing tests.
Outcome-blind methods gate required at least 8 paired models per tissue; overlap was Endometrium 5, Large Intestine 17, Ovary 17, Stomach 8. Stopped without computing cross-source WRN ordering.

Frozen a distinct two-tissue ordering analysis with 17 Large Intestine and 17 Ovary overlap models, full source-tissue rank denominators, equal-tissue Spearman mean, stratified inference, and explicit post-unsealing derived-analysis label before computing any model-ordering outcome.
